mod.overview: VXO Release 1.0 by Nimec (2002) builds on VXC. It restores the four mini turrets that VXC sold without datablocks (the Mini-S.A.M stays out of the shop), makes the air brake a dead stop, speeds up the light-armor boost, and retunes several weapons and packs. Like VXC it has no VX damage-type side effects and no profile or difficulty switching.
notes: Player::onDamage is VXC's: no EMP, beam or MiniELF item drops, no bullet head-shot gib. Flag-carrier kills give +1 or -1 score.
Grenade and Beacon still come from Mine.cs, which runs after item.cs and overrides the item.cs versions.
$BrakeSpeed is -0.0 for every armor, so the brake multiplies your velocity by zero. Light armor's boost factor is 3.15 (VXC 2.75).
Mini-turret team limits: Mini-Flak 5, Mini-ELF 5, Mini-Beam Of Pain 10, Mini-S.A.M 0 (also removed from the station lists).

Stat changes against VXC include faster-firing Blaster, Chaingun and LiL POO rifles, a 0.25 s LiLFFB reload, and lower energy costs for the Shield Pack (8 per second) and StealthShield Pack (2 per second).
The entry script switches the public votes on (the values the later VXE shipped); a super admin can change them under VXO Admin: God Ctrls.

MiniFlakTurretPack.summary: Deploys a Mini-Flak Turret that launches short-lived seeking flak missiles. Unlike VXC, the turret exists and works.
notes: turret.cs defines MiniFlakTurret again, with range 125 m (VX5 75) and a 1 s reload (VX5 2 s).
Deploy rules are VX5's: floors, walls or ceilings, fair-play rule, kills credited to the deployer.
Team limit 5.

MiniSAMTurretPack.summary: The Mini-S.A.M Turret pack. Its turret is defined again, but the pack is taken out of the shop.
notes: turret.cs defines MiniSAMTurret again with range 125 m (VX5 100) and a 2 s reload (VX5 4 s).
$InvList and $RemoteInvList are 0 and the team limit is 0, so players cannot buy one.

MiniELFTurretPack.summary: Deploys a Mini-ELF Turret, a wide-cone lightning turret that drains energy. Unlike VXC, the turret exists and works.
notes: Range 40 m (VX5 60). It still drains 1000 energy per second, but this mod's Player::onDamage has no MiniELF effect, so victims keep their pack and weapon.
Deploy rules are VX5's; kills credited to the deployer. Team limit 5.
MiniELFTurretPack.source: item.cs MiniELFTurretPack::deployShape; turret.cs MiniELFTurret; player.cs Player::onDamage

MiniSmokeTurretPack.summary: Deploys a Mini-Beam Of Pain, a thick damaging beam turret. Unlike VXC, the turret exists and works.
notes: Same turret as VX5 (range 40 m, 2-second bursts), but its MiniELF-type hits no longer make the victim drop anything.
Deploy rules are VX5's; kills credited to the deployer. Team limit 10.

RepairKit.summary: A one-use medkit that heals 0.99 damage.
notes: Same heal as VXC; it now also prints Action: You use a Repair Kit.

Grenade.summary: An impulse brake that stops you dead in the air.
notes: Runs the Mine.cs version: throws a zero-damage Boost charge forward, then multiplies your velocity by BrakeSpeed x VelRatio. With BrakeSpeed -0.0 for every armor, your velocity becomes zero.
Prints Impulse Break Activated. 0.2 s between uses (VXC 0.5); uses one grenade each time.

Beacon.summary: A speed booster that multiplies your velocity by a per-armor factor, faster for light armor than in VXC.
notes: Runs the Mine.cs version: throws the zero-damage Boost charge forward, then multiplies your velocity by BoostSpeed[armor] x VelRatio, where VelRatio = (SpeedMax - |x speed|) / SpeedMax.
BoostSpeed is 3.15 for light (VXC 2.75), 2.2 medium, 1.7 heavy; SpeedMax 200/120/95. Above SpeedMax on the x axis the ratio goes negative and reverses you.
0.2 s between uses (VXC 0.5); uses one beacon each time. Prints You use a Speed Booster.
